use_for: Instant access, fast or easy download/delivery with no problems.

theme: Wants a specific extra tracker or feature
use_for: Names a feature/tab to add (no-spend days, check register, total debt, per-card amounts, monthly expense sheets, transactions log, separate sheets).

theme: Forced survey or upsell to get the file
use_for: Had to fill a questionnaire or got pushed to a paid service before receiving the download.

theme: Good for budgeting with a partner
use_for: Easy to share or plan together with a spouse, partner or family.
Has to type, copy-paste or re-enter totals by hand instead of it being automatic.

theme: Doesn't track account balances or transfers well
use_for: Can't see running cash/account balances; transfers between accounts or debit/credit mix throw off numbers.
Wants an added tab or tracker, e.g. quarterly taxes or money paid back.
Long loading, lag or freezing when editing; poor performance.
Wants to change the built-in split or method (e.g. 50/30/20 to another ratio).
Wants yearly totals or a full-year overview of spending.
Wants bill due dates or payment reminders built in.
Uneasy about storing finances in Google or online.
Received an older version than the current one the seller offers.

theme: Can't share with family or partner
use_for: Lock or permissions stop sharing the sheet with others.
Likes that data stays on own computer instead of an app.
Praises that it opened fine in Excel, Numbers or another app.
